newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock has no information on placement.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock has no information on placement.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd said on Thursday that "to the best of Wheelock's understanding", no substantial shareholder, director or other connected person was involved in a recent share placement.

"Wheelock would also confirm that to the best of its knowledge (after having made due enquiry), Barclays Private Bank and Trust Limited (which is a substantial shareholder of Wheelock) has not altered their shareholding interests in Wheelock," the statement said.
A block of 50 million Wheelock shares was traded at HK$22.80 on Wednesday.
Market sources said on Tuesday that Barclays Private Bank, which held 59.14 percent of Wheelock as of October 1996, was hoping to place 50 million existing shares at about HK$22.80.
Wheelock said it had not received any relevant information from any of the parties concerned.
The stock closed at HK$22.90 on Wednesday.
